description: The hunk model of the Review tab (ui/src/lib/review-hunks.ts): lines that keep their terminator, the hunks with three lines of context, undoing a hunk byte for byte, the fingerprint of a hunk and the accepted marks, judged by ui/tests/review-hunks.test.mjs. tests/ui-review-for-mutation.mjs runs that file in the copy of the Hub that the runner makes; the copy has no node_modules, so it borrows the diff package from the folder the copy was made from. ui/src/lib/review-source.ts holds types only and has nothing to mutate.

mutations.name: RH-context-two
mutations.what: two lines of context instead of three

mutations.name: RH-context-four
mutations.what: four lines of context instead of three

mutations.name: RH-edit-limit-low
mutations.what: the search gives up at 100 changed lines, so a file with 400 separate changes becomes one hunk

mutations.name: RH-edit-limit-high
mutations.what: the search gives up at 5000 changed lines, so 600 scattered changes are searched one by one

mutations.name: RH-merge-gap-five
mutations.what: changes six lines apart are two hunks

mutations.name: RH-merge-gap-seven
mutations.what: changes seven lines apart are one hunk

mutations.name: RH-split-drops-feed
mutations.what: a line loses its line feed when the text is cut

mutations.name: RH-split-last-line-lost
mutations.what: a last line without a terminator is dropped

mutations.name: RH-split-on-cr
mutations.what: a carriage return ends a line instead of a line feed

mutations.name: RH-join-with-feed
mutations.what: lines are joined with a line feed between them

mutations.name: RH-prefix-not-trimmed
mutations.what: the lines the two texts share at the start are not left out before the search

patches.old: while (head < a.length && head < b.length && a[head] === b[head]) head += 1;
patches.new: while (head < 0 && head < b.length && a[head] === b[head]) head += 1;

mutations.name: RH-suffix-not-trimmed
mutations.what: the lines the two texts share at the end are not left out before the search

patches.old: while (tail < a.length - head && tail < b.length - head

mutations.name: RH-suffix-overlaps-prefix
mutations.what: the shared end may run into the shared start (x x x against x x)

patches.old: while (tail < a.length - head && tail < b.length - head

mutations.name: RH-equal-files-one-side
mutations.what: a text with nothing but lines added is taken for the same text

mutations.name: RH-one-side-empty-shortcut
mutations.what: a pure insertion or deletion goes through the search instead of the shortcut
mutations.equivalent: the shortcut only skips a call of diffArrays, which for an empty list against a list of lines gives the same single added or removed part and so the same block

mutations.name: RH-edit-limit-removed
mutations.what: the search has no limit

mutations.name: RH-fallback-no-hunk
mutations.what: when the search gives up there is no hunk at all

mutations.name: RH-block-never-pushed
mutations.what: a block that an unchanged run closes is forgotten

mutations.name: RH-block-never-closed
mutations.what: a block stays open after an unchanged run and grows over it

mutations.name: RH-last-block-lost
mutations.what: the block that is still open at the end of the file is forgotten

mutations.name: RH-unchanged-skips-current
mutations.what: an unchanged run moves the position in the baseline only

mutations.name: RH-unchanged-skips-baseline
mutations.what: an unchanged run moves the position in the current text only

mutations.name: RH-replacement-split
mutations.what: the lines added after lines taken away start a block of their own

patches.old: open ??= { aStart: at, aEnd: at, bStart: to, bEnd: to };
patches.new: open = { aStart: at, aEnd: at, bStart: to, bEnd: to };

mutations.name: RH-block-starts-at-head
mutations.what: a block starts where the first change was, not where it is

patches.old: open ??= { aStart: at, aEnd: at, bStart: to, bEnd: to };
patches.new: open ??= { aStart: head, aEnd: at, bStart: to, bEnd: to };

mutations.name: RH-removed-not-counted
mutations.what: lines taken away do not move the position in the baseline

mutations.name: RH-removed-end-stuck
mutations.what: the end of a block in the baseline is never moved

mutations.name: RH-added-not-counted
mutations.what: lines added do not move the position in the current text

mutations.name: RH-added-end-stuck
mutations.what: the end of a block in the current text is never moved

mutations.name: RH-added-read-as-removed
mutations.what: lines added are counted as lines taken away and the other way round

mutations.name: RH-unchanged-test
mutations.what: a part is unchanged when it is not added or not removed

mutations.name: RH-group-never
mutations.what: no two blocks are ever grouped

mutations.name: RH-group-strict
mutations.what: blocks six lines apart are not grouped

mutations.name: RH-group-always
mutations.what: every block is grouped with the one before

mutations.name: RH-group-from-first
mutations.what: the distance is measured from the first block of the group, not from the last

mutations.name: RH-visible-keeps-bom
mutations.what: a byte order mark counts as part of what a line says

patches.old: const text = line.charCodeAt(0) === BYTE_ORDER_MARK ? line.slice(1) : line;

mutations.name: RH-visible-keeps-terminator
mutations.what: a line ending counts as part of what a line says

mutations.name: RH-visible-lf-only
mutations.what: only the line feed of a CRLF ending is put aside

mutations.name: RH-bom-code
mutations.what: another character is taken for the byte order mark

mutations.name: RH-no-interior-context
mutations.what: the unchanged lines between two changes of one hunk are left out of its rows

mutations.name: RH-removed-text-current
mutations.what: a removed row shows the current line

mutations.name: RH-added-text-baseline
mutations.what: an added row shows the baseline line

mutations.name: RH-context-before-max
mutations.what: the context before the first line is the larger of three and its place

mutations.name: RH-context-before-fixed
mutations.what: three lines of context are asked for before a change at the top of the file

mutations.name: RH-baseline-start-current
mutations.what: the start in the baseline is the start in the current text

mutations.name: RH-baseline-end-current
mutations.what: the end in the baseline is the end in the current text

mutations.name: RH-current-start-baseline
mutations.what: the start in the current text is the start in the baseline

mutations.name: RH-current-end-baseline
mutations.what: the end in the current text is the end in the baseline

mutations.name: RH-removed-count-swapped
mutations.what: the count of lines taken away is the count of lines added

patches.old: removed: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.aEnd - block.aStart, 0),
patches.new: removed: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.bEnd - block.bStart, 0),

mutations.name: RH-added-count-swapped
mutations.what: the count of lines added is the count of lines taken away

patches.old: added: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.bEnd - block.bStart, 0),
patches.new: added: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.aEnd - block.aStart, 0),

mutations.name: RH-removed-count-first-block
mutations.what: only the first block of a hunk counts lines taken away

mutations.name: RH-added-count-first-block
mutations.what: only the first block of a hunk counts lines added

mutations.name: RH-invisible-lengths-ignored
mutations.what: a block that adds lines to lines that look the same is invisible

mutations.name: RH-invisible-raw-compare
mutations.what: lines are compared with their terminators, so no hunk is invisible

mutations.name: RH-invisible-some-block
mutations.what: a hunk is invisible when one of its blocks is

mutations.name: RH-invisible-first-block-only
mutations.what: only the first block of a hunk is looked at

mutations.name: RH-invisible-across-blocks
mutations.what: the lines taken away by all the blocks of a hunk are paired with the lines put in their place by all of them, so a line that moved looks the same

patches.new: invisibleOnly: ((gone, put) => gone.length === put.length && gone.every((words, at) => words === put[at]))(blocks.flatMap((block) => wordsOf(baselineLines, block.aStart, block.aEnd)), blocks.flatMap((block) => wordsOf(currentLines, block.bStart, block.bEnd))),

mutations.name: RH-fingerprint-no-place
mutations.what: the fingerprint does not say where in the baseline the hunk is

mutations.name: RH-fingerprint-no-kind
mutations.what: the fingerprint does not tell a line added from a line taken away

mutations.name: RH-fingerprint-no-length
mutations.what: the lines in the fingerprint are not told apart where one ends and the next begins

mutations.name: RH-rows-without-changes
mutations.what: the rows of a hunk are its context only

mutations.name: RH-rows-extra-context-after
mutations.what: four lines of context after a hunk

mutations.name: RH-rows-extra-context-before
mutations.what: four lines of context before a hunk

mutations.name: RH-index-always-zero
mutations.what: every hunk says it is the first

mutations.name: RH-diff-swapped
mutations.what: the baseline is compared as if it were the current text

mutations.name: RH-reject-inverted
mutations.what: the hunks that were not chosen are undone

mutations.name: RH-reject-everything
mutations.what: every hunk is undone whichever was chosen

mutations.name: RH-reject-prefix-from-start
mutations.what: the text before a hunk is taken from the top of the file, not from the end of the last hunk

mutations.name: RH-reject-baseline-too-long
mutations.what: one baseline line too many is put back

mutations.name: RH-reject-cursor-start
mutations.what: after a hunk is undone the text goes on from the start of the hunk, not from its end

mutations.name: RH-reject-no-tail
mutations.what: the text after the last hunk is dropped

mutations.name: RH-reject-no-set
mutations.what: the chosen hunks are not put in a set, so a list of indexes cannot be asked about

mutations.name: RH-reject-one-index
mutations.what: undoing one hunk always undoes the first

mutations.name: RH-reject-all-none
mutations.what: undoing all hunks undoes none

mutations.name: RH-hash-offset
mutations.what: the start value of the hash is one off

mutations.name: RH-hash-prime
mutations.what: the multiplier of the hash is one off

mutations.name: RH-hash-fnv1
mutations.what: the hash multiplies before it mixes in the character (FNV-1, not FNV-1a)

mutations.name: RH-hash-63-bits
mutations.what: the hash keeps 63 bits

mutations.name: RH-hash-code-point
mutations.what: the hash reads code points, not UTF-16 units

mutations.name: RH-hash-no-padding
mutations.what: a hash that starts with a zero digit is shorter than sixteen digits

mutations.name: RH-hash-loop-past-end
mutations.what: the hash reads one position past the end of the text

patches.old: for (let at = 0; at < text.length; at += 1) hash
patches.new: for (let at = 0; at <= text.length; at += 1) hash

mutations.name: RH-accept-mutates
mutations.what: accepting a hunk changes the set it was given

mutations.name: RH-accept-always-copies
mutations.what: accepting a hunk that is accepted already gives a new set

mutations.name: RH-accept-by-index
mutations.what: a hunk is accepted by its number, not by its fingerprint

mutations.name: RH-accepts-start-empty
mutations.what: accepting several hunks forgets what was accepted before

mutations.name: RH-pending-inverted
mutations.what: the pending hunks are the accepted ones

mutations.name: RH-pending-by-index
mutations.what: a hunk is pending when its number is not in the set

mutations.name: RH-fingerprint-current-place
mutations.what: the fingerprint is taken from where the hunk is in the current text instead of in the baseline, so lines put in above it change it

mutations.name: RH-fingerprint-hunk-number
mutations.what: the fingerprint is taken from the hunk's number instead of its place, so undoing an earlier hunk renumbers the others and changes it

mutations.name: RH-coarse-current-end-from-baseline
mutations.what: the one hunk made when the search gives up ends in the current text where it ends in the baseline, which is wrong when the two have different numbers of lines

mutations.name: RH-coarse-baseline-end-from-current
mutations.what: the one hunk made when the search gives up ends in the baseline where it ends in the current text, which is wrong when the two have different numbers of lines

mutations.name: RH-edit-limit-one-less
mutations.what: the search gives up one changed line early, so a file with exactly 1,000 changed lines is no longer searched

mutations.name: RH-edit-limit-one-more
mutations.what: the search gives up one changed line late, so a file with 1,001 changed lines is still searched
